extension.summary: Fetch subtitles via your Bazarr server
extension.description: Searches and downloads subtitles by delegating to an existing Bazarr instance instead of scraping subtitle sites directly. Bazarr does the provider work server-side; this addon just asks it for results and tells it what to download. Requires the currently playing movie/episode to already be indexed in Bazarr via Radarr/Sonarr, and requires Kodi and Bazarr to see the media files at the same path (shared mount).
